call_points.text: Closed FY26 with preferred bidder status worth over $400 million in the Middle East and Africa region.
Middle East funding for new projects has been scaled back, delaying them about 6 to 8 months; ongoing projects and payments are unaffected.
Shipping costs and transit times have risen and ports are congested, a minor supply-chain impact management expects to manage.
About 70 to 80 projects are under execution at any time: roughly 15-20 abroad and 50-60 in India.
Plans to build more than 100 compressed biogas plants over the next few years, helped by the new GOBARdhan scheme.
BLUE SEED: took a 10% equity stake in Bengaluru-based Nimble Vision in April 2026 and is evaluating more startups.
Credit rating reaffirmed at IND AA- stable long-term and A1+ short-term.
Board recommended a final dividend of ₹5 per share for FY26, up from ₹4 the previous year.
Management maintains medium-term guidance of 15% to 20% revenue CAGR and EBITDA margins between 13% to 15%.
Order backlog closed at ₹17,200 crore, backed by order inflows of about ₹7,500 crore in FY26.
Focus remains asset-light with low gross block, relying on technology and engineering capabilities rather than heavy manufacturing assets.
O&M order backlog stands at around ₹6,500 crore, acting as a high-margin, recurring revenue driver.
New growth verticals include ultra-pure water for semiconductors and solar PV cells, data centers, and green hydrogen.

entities.name: North Chennai Tru Water Private Limited

industry: Utilities > Other Utilities > Water Supply & Management

operating_notes.text: Incorporated North Chennai Tru Water Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to handle the RFOMT of a 45 MLD TTRO plant at Kodungaiyur, Chennai.
Order Intake exceeded ₹7,500 Cr in FY26, bringing order book to over ₹17,200 Cr including Framework contracts.
Sixth consecutive year of net cash positive operations with a net cash position of ₹833.7 Cr.
Secured a medium-value DBO order from Delhi Jal Board for a 17 MGD WWTP at Mitraon with 15 years O&M.
Order intake exceeded ₹75 Bn in FY26, bringing the order book to over ₹17,200 Cr.
O&M backlog is almost 40% of the ₹17,200 Cr order book, about ₹6,500 Cr, with contracts of 5 to 20 years.
Net working capital days are around 100 and ROCE 19.4% for FY26.
Al-Haer 200 MLD STP in the Middle East is at 83% physical progress and on track for commissioning.
Order book of over ₹17,200 Cr at FY26 year-end, about US $1.8 billion, with over 35% from long-term O&M contracts of 15-20 years.
About 70-80 projects under execution at any time: roughly 15-20 abroad and 50-60 in India.
Closed FY26 with preferred bidder status worth over $400 million in the Middle East and Africa region.
Secured a Mega order from Reliance Industries for a 302 MLD Desalination Plant and 3,000 m3/hr Remineralisation Plant at Jamnagar, Gujarat, to be executed over 25 months.
